name: Algiers (Algeria)
description: A vertical bicolour of blue at the hoist and green at the fly, charged at the centre with the coat of arms of Algiers.
history: The city's arms were adopted by the municipal council in 1862 under French rule, with blue for France and green for Islam, and were redrawn after independence. No adoption date for the flag has been published.

features.role: arms of Algiers with lion, ship and wheat sheaf
